_about: First-time tutorials. Each tour runs the first time its screen opens; the ? button replays it. A step points at the first element matching `target` (a CSS selector); with no target, or none on screen, the card sits in the middle. `unlock` skips the tour until that feature opens.

steps.title: Welcome to the farm
steps.text: This is where most days start. Here's a quick look around. Tap Next to keep going, or Skip if you'd rather explore.

steps.title: Coins
steps.text: Everything you grow, catch and make can be sold for coins. You'll spend them on seeds, animals and upgrades.

steps.title: Stamina
steps.text: Exploring and mining use stamina. It refills on its own, and meals from the kitchen top it up.

steps.title: Your six skills
steps.text: Everything you do earns experience. Each new level unlocks seeds, places, recipes or a bonus. Tap one to see how close the next level is.

steps.title: Your journal
steps.text: The main story lives here, along with Wren's lost journal pages. A red dot means the story needs you.

steps.title: What to do next
steps.text: The next story step always shows up here. Tap it to read what's needed or to talk to someone.

steps.title: Seed packets
steps.text: Pick a packet. Each one shows how long it takes to grow and what the crop sells for. More unlock as your Farming level goes up.

steps.title: Your fields
steps.text: Tap an empty plot to sow the packet you picked. Crops grow in real time, even while you're away. Tap Ready plots to harvest.

steps.title: One plot, or the whole field
steps.text: Harvest or sow here. The Big Basket and Seed Bag perks in your Bag let you do several plots in one tap.

steps.title: The rest of the valley
steps.text: The wilds, fishing, crafting, the town and your bag are all down here. Each one shows a quick tour the first time you open it.

steps.title: The story so far
steps.text: Each chapter has a few steps. Finished ones get a tick. The current one shows exactly what's still needed.

steps.title: Wren's journal pages
steps.text: Every chapter you finish turns up one of Wren's lost pages. Tap a page to read it.

steps.title: Plant once, pick forever
steps.text: A tree costs coins once and keeps fruiting. Each one holds two harvests, so check back before it fills up.

steps.title: Pick everything
steps.text: Pick every ripe tree in one tap.

steps.title: Your animals
steps.text: Each animal makes something on its own: eggs, milk, honey or wool. Collect it before the pen fills up.

steps.title: Once a day
steps.text: Tap each animal once a day to pet it, for a little bonus. They like it too.

steps.title: A friend for the farm
steps.text: Pets wander off and bring things home: flowers, fish or shiny stones. Their favourite snack makes them twice as quick for the day.

steps.title: Choose a place
steps.text: Tap a place to go there. Each one has its own finds; the ones you haven't found yet show as a question mark. New places open with your Foraging level and the story.

steps.title: Get to know it
steps.text: Every trip you make in a place counts toward its rank. Each rank makes rare finds likelier there, and pays coins once.

steps.title: Head out
steps.text: Each trip costs 1 stamina and finds something, or nothing. The back button takes you to the other places.

steps.title: Found here
steps.text: Everything this place hides, and how many of each you've found here. Tap one to see what it's for.

steps.title: Its rank
steps.text: Trips here raise this place's rank. Each rank makes rare finds a little likelier here and pays coins once.

steps.title: Dig for ore and gems
steps.text: Every dig costs 1 stamina. Deeper floors hide better ore, gems and, very far down, star shards.

steps.title: Finding the way down
steps.text: Keep digging until you find the way down, then take it. Floors 10, 20 and 25 need a higher Mining level.

steps.title: The old lift
steps.text: Once you reach a landing, the lift can take you straight back to it next time.

steps.title: Where to fish
steps.text: Tap a spot to go there. Each one has its own fish. New waters open with the story and your Fishing level.

steps.title: Bait
steps.text: Every cast uses one bait. Worms are cheap at the store. Lures widen the green zone. Glow grubs tempt the legendary fish.

steps.title: Cast and wait
steps.text: Tap Cast, then wait for the bobber to dip. When the bar appears, tap the button again while the marker is inside the green zone.

steps.title: One button does it all
steps.text: This button casts, reels in and casts again. Tap it the moment the marker is inside the green zone.

steps.title: In these waters
steps.text: Every catch here counts toward this spot's rank. Each rank makes rare fish a little likelier here and pays coins once.

steps.title: Recipes
steps.text: Each recipe turns raw goods into something worth more, or something people need. More unlock as your Crafting level rises.

steps.title: What it takes
steps.text: These show what you have and what you need. Red means you're short.

steps.title: Make one at a time
steps.text: Craft one at a time. The Batch Maker perk in your Bag lets you make several at once.

steps.title: Cooking
steps.text: Meals are worth a lot more than their ingredients. Many also restore stamina or give a boost for a while.

steps.title: Boosts
steps.text: Active boosts show at the top of the screen with the time left, like Lucky or Steady Hands.

steps.title: Crafts while you're away
steps.text: Queue up a recipe and the bench makes them one at a time, even with the game closed. It uses the materials up front.

steps.title: Come back and collect
steps.text: Take whatever's finished whenever you like. Stopping early gives back the materials for anything not yet made.

steps.title: Patience pays
steps.text: Fill a cask and leave it. It's ready to bottle after a while, but leave it longer and it becomes a vintage worth more than twice as much.

steps.title: Your neighbours
steps.text: Everyone in the valley has their own story. More people turn up as you explore further.

steps.title: Friendship
steps.text: Hearts grow when you help, chat and give gifts. At certain hearts they'll share something personal with you.

steps.title: Requests
steps.text: Each person asks for something in turn. Bring what they need, tap Give items, and they'll pay you back well.

steps.title: One gift a day
steps.text: Give each person one gift a day. Everyone has favourites. Finding them out is half the fun.

steps.title: The general store
steps.text: Bait, extra farm plots and barn upgrades. A bigger barn holds more of each item.

steps.title: The Valley Exchange
steps.text: Prices here change every few hours. Green arrows pay more than usual. Watch for your best crops going up.

steps.title: Daily gift
steps.text: Open a gift each day you visit. Come back days in a row and the gifts get bigger.

steps.title: This season's festival
steps.text: Each season brings a festival. Fill its requests for ribbons, and spend them at the stall, including a keepsake you can only get this season.

steps.title: Today's chores
steps.text: Three small goals that change every midnight. Tap Claim when one is done.

steps.title: Letters
steps.text: Folks write as they get to know you. Some letters come with a small gift inside, so open them all.

steps.title: Everything you own
steps.text: Tap any item to sell it, lock it, eat it, or see where it comes from and who loves it.

steps.title: Sell all
steps.text: Sell a whole group at once. Locked items are always kept.

steps.title: More in here
steps.text: The almanac tracks everything you've found and your mastery stars. Feats are achievements. Perks are bonuses you choose.

steps.title: Perk points
steps.text: You earn a point for every few skill levels across all six skills.

steps.title: Pick your bonuses
steps.text: Spend points on whatever suits how you play: faster crops, better prices, more stamina and more. You can refund them later for a few coins.

steps.title: The inn
steps.text: Tess runs the inn and keeps the quest board. Drop in for a rumor of the day about where to look next.

steps.title: The quest board
steps.text: Quests are short stories with choices. The diamonds show how tricky they are. Some open as the story goes on, and delves turn up when you dig deep enough.

steps.title: Bring a friend
steps.text: Friends at three hearts or more can come along. When a roll matches what they're good at, you roll two dice and keep the better one.

steps.title: Rolling the dice
steps.text: Some choices on a quest need a dice roll. The game rolls a 20-sided die for you, adds your bonus, and checks it against a target number. You'll see your chance before you choose, and a friend along makes it easier.

steps.title: Your character sheet
steps.text: Your background, level and Inspiration (✦). Inspiration is a second chance: spend one to roll the dice again after a miss.

steps.title: Roll bonuses
steps.text: When a choice needs a dice roll, this number is added to the die. Bigger numbers make success more likely. Your background gives one skill an extra +2.

steps.title: Charms
steps.text: Wear up to three charms for small, lasting bonuses. Rare ones turn up on quests, in delves and from new creature friends.

steps.title: Creatures of the valley
steps.text: Gentle creatures live all over the valley. Meet them while exploring or digging, win them over, and they are recorded here.

steps.title: This choice needs a dice roll
steps.text: Some choices aren't certain. When you pick one, the game rolls a 20-sided die for you: a number from 1 to 20, like flipping a very big coin.

steps.title: What the numbers mean
steps.text: "Need 11 or more" is the target. The die plus your bonus has to reach it. The percentage is your chance of success, already worked out for you.

steps.title: No wrong answers
steps.text: Failing a roll never hurts you. The story just goes a different way. Pick whatever sounds fun.

steps.title: Your die
steps.text: This is a 20-sided die, called a d20. It landed on the number in the middle. Sometimes two dice appear: a friend is helping, so you keep the better one and the other fades out.

steps.title: Your target and your bonus
steps.text: Your bonus comes from your skill level, your background and any charms. It gets added to the die, and the total has to reach the target.

steps.title: The result
steps.text: A 20 is the best roll there is. It always works and gives you Inspiration. A 1 always goes a little wrong, but only in a funny way.

steps.title: Carry on
steps.text: Tap Continue to see what happens next. If you have Inspiration (✦), you can spend it to roll again after a miss.

steps.title: Inspiration
steps.text: That roll missed, but you have Inspiration (✦). Spend one to roll again, or tap Continue to see where the story goes. Either way is fine.

steps.title: The battlefield
steps.text: Your side is on the left, the foes are on the right. The bar under each one is their hit points. When it runs out, they're out of the fight.

steps.title: Front row and back row
steps.text: Whoever stands at the front protects the back. Swords and claws can only reach the front row until it's empty. Bows and spells reach anyone.

steps.title: Taking turns
steps.text: Everyone takes a turn in order. Each attack rolls a 20-sided die plus a bonus. If the total reaches the target's armour, it hits. The log shows every roll.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: On your turn, pick a move, then tap who to use it on. Friends who came along take their own turns. Losing costs nothing: everyone just limps home.

steps.title: Everyone fights this one
steps.text: Every neighbour in your village is fighting the same boss, from the website or from Claude. It stays for two days.

steps.title: Two bars to fill
steps.text: Each phase has a Might bar and a Magic bar. Fill both and the boss moves to its next phase. Beat the last phase and the village wins.

steps.title: Strike or cast
steps.text: Each attack costs 1 courage, and courage refills fully every hour. Your class hits its own bar harder: fighters, rogues and rangers on Might, wizards, clerics and bards on Magic.

steps.title: Rewards for joining in
steps.text: When the boss falls, everyone who fought gets coins and battle experience for every attack they made, plus a victory share.
